title: ClientIntake
description: Operator intake for one US A2P 10DLC client. EIN and tax ID are operator-held: validate them in the client folder, never commit a real value, and never put one in this repository. Examples use the placeholder XX-XXXXXXX.

client_ref.description: Short stable id used on the case tracker. No spaces.

legal_name.description: Legal entity name as it should appear on the brand. Must match tax or formation records.

ein_or_tax_id.description: Operator-held. Store outside git. Use null only for a sole proprietor path that has no EIN. Placeholder for docs and examples: XX-XXXXXXX.

website.description: Public site that matches the use case and is reachable at filing time.

use_case.description: One sentence: who texts whom, and why.

opt_in_url.description: Public page or screen where the recipient opts in. Screenshot lives in the client folder.

sample_messages.description: Two to five samples that match the live product, including brand name and STOP where the CSP requires it.

summary.description: Plain-language volume, for example about 200 messages per day.

vertical.description: Honest industry label. Dating and social dating stay high-scrutiny. Prohibited SHAFT, cannabis, and gambling promotions are do-not-file.
